title: Data Breach Accountability and Enforcement Act of 2017
short_title: Data Breach Accountability and Enforcement Act of 2017

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

summaries.text:
Data Breach Accountability and Enforcement Act of 2017
 This bill requires an entity that acquires, maintains, or utilizes personal information in commerce to have in effect specified cybersecurity protections and practices. The Federal Trade Commission must enforce the requirement using specified procedures.
